text:
maria (marketing): Hey team — heads up we're aiming to announce the Adaptive Routing release the week of 3/30. Need final changelog, docs link, confirmed rollout timing, and a short benchmark blurb for the press/webinar. :rocket:

alex (eng): working on changelog PR now. there's one small API tweak for routing weights — nothing user-breaking if they use defaults, but we should mention the new `routing_policy` field. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/changelog/pulls/842

nina (docs): I can draft the docs page once I have the API diff + example requests. Can you paste the minimal curl/sample JSON?

alex (eng): minimal example (will add to docs):
```
POST /v1/route
{
  "model": "rwd-adaptive-v1",
  "routing_policy": { "type": "latency_aware", "fallback": "rwd-standard" }
}
```

jasper (product): Messaging note — emphasize predictable latency + cost savings. Marketing should call out: "up to 15% lower cost per token in typical web workloads" (we'll confirm numbers). Also, highlight canary + automatic fallback in case of regressions.

maria (marketing): good — can we get a one-liner benchmark: p95 latency and cost delta? that'll go in the announcement and webinar slides. Also need the canonical docs link and changelog URL to include in the changelog section.

alex (eng): quick numbers from internal perf run (N=10k requests, seq_len=128): p95 baseline: 120ms -> adaptive: 102ms, avg token cost delta: -14%. I'll put these in the PR with full test details.

sam (ops): Deploy schedule question: do we want a rolling canary or a region-gated roll? We can do a 2% canary in us-west for 4 hours, then 20% global ramp if healthy. Need approval for the 4h window.

maria (marketing): prefer region-gated + small canary, want the docs and changelog published at the time the first canary goes live so we can point early customers. Can we coordinate the doc publish time?

nina (docs): I'll time the publishing. Once alex posts the final API diff + example, I'll merge the docs draft and schedule it to go live at canary start. Link will be: https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/adaptive-routing (draft until publish).

alex (eng): note: there is a migration note for customers who pin `model: rwd-standard`. We should include a small snippet in the changelog: how to opt-in to adaptive routing via `routing_policy`. I'll add that to the PR.

jasper (product): For SFDC inbound lead routing: marketing -> sales should tag customers who attended webinar + requested early access. Sam, can you add a webhook/gated flag so we can auto-tag?

sam (ops): yes — we can set an internal `feature_canary` flag on accounts in staging. I'll open a small task to hook to the CRM: OPS ticket #455.

maria (marketing): Webinar planning: aiming for Apr 2, 10am PT. Speakers: jasper (product), alex (eng), and a customer if we secure one. Marketing to produce slides with 1 slide of benchmarks, 1 slide of rollout plan, 1 slide of migration steps.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job #deploy-175555 for 2026-03-30T15:00:00Z. Canary targets: us-west-2 (2%), global ramp options queued.

alex (eng): recommend canary policy: 2% for 4h, health checks every 5m, auto-fallback to `rwd-standard` if error rate > 0.5% or p95 regresses > 20%. Snippet for the runbook: 
```
canary: { percent: 2, duration: 4h, health_checks: [error_rate, p95_latency], rollback_if: {error_rate: 0.005, p95_regression: 0.2} }
```

maria (marketing): perfect. can you add a tiny blurb for the press: one sentence about latency and one about cost? I'll iterate wording.

alex (eng): draft: "Adaptive Routing reduces p95 inference latency by ~15% in typical web workloads while lowering per-token cost by ~14% via smarter routing and caching."

maria (marketing): nice — I'll refine to match brand voice. Also need a short FAQ item about data residency for Dedicated customers (they'll ask).

sam (ops): Dedicated customers: no change to data residency. Adaptive Routing runs inside configured VPC/pool and respects KMS keys. I'll add that to the FAQ note.

nina (docs): Request: marketing, please confirm exact headline copy and link to slide deck assets when ready. I can embed the curl example and the canary runbook into the docs.

maria (marketing): Will do. I'll post the final headline + 3 tweets + webinar landing page copy by EOD Friday. Can everyone react with :eyes: when docs/changelog PRs are ready so marketing can lock copy?

alex (eng): will ping here when PR is merged.

jasper (product): also: notify customer success to prioritize onboarding requests for early access. I'll open CS ticket now.

maria (marketing): Excellent — thanks all. I'll create the webinar invite and landing page draft and loop in sales for inbound routing rules. :thumbsup:

sam (ops): I'll confirm the CRM webhook ticket and post the OPS ticket link here when ready.

maria (marketing): Thanks — let's try to keep this tight. Ping me if you hit any blocking issues. :calendar:
